title: Inherited TRADITIONAL IRA — no step-up exists at all
catches: A basis step-up applied to income in respect of a decedent.
authority: IRC 691(c) (deduction for estate tax on IRD)
notes: READ THIS ONE BY HAND. IRC 1014(c): section 1014 does not apply to IRD. There is no partial step-up, no step-up requiring verification — none. The IRD branch of BasisModel must have NO taxBasis field, so that copying value-at-death into basis is a COMPILE ERROR. $425,000 is a reporting figure and an estate value. It is not basis and can never become basis.
